Work record > general (inf-use-1): Draft contract, term sheet, unsigned notice, draft board resolution; draft pleading or statement of case, draft witness statement, draft skeleton argument, draft consent order, draft charge or indictment
Work record > key (inf-use-2): Executed agreement, signed deed, final notice with legal effect, board resolution authorised and signed; filed pleading or statement of case, sealed court order, final judgment or decree, executed settlement agreement, regulatory enforcement notice, charging document
Knowledge > contextual (inf-use-3): Prior agreement with the same counterparty or on the same subject matter (e.g. to check for inconsistent terms or obligations); prior pleading or order involving the same party or arising from the same facts (e.g. a prior injunction, a related regulatory notice, a settlement agreement whose terms are relevant to subsequent proceedings)
Knowledge > good practice (inf-use-4): Example of a well-structured agreement on a recurring transaction type; clause library entry; example well-drafted statement of claim or particulars of claim; precedent skeleton argument or written submission on a standard legal issue; example consent order or agreed form of relief
Knowledge > canonical (inf-use-5): Standard form agreement adopted by the organisation (e.g. house form NDA, ISDA master, approved board resolution template); approved precedent pleadings or claim forms for standard matter types; standard form orders for routine applications; mandatory form of charge or indictment where prescribed by rules or practice direction
